This petition is filed by the Petitioner against Respondent No.1 & 2 under Sec.166 of

Scch5
2.
The brief facts of the case is as under; That on 03.11.202

2 at about 4.45 p.m. he had been riding motor cycle bearing Reg.No.KA40EF2005 along with his wife as pillion rider near Chenduru Cross, Gudibande Taluk, Chikkaballapura, a Bolero Goods Carrier Vehicle bearing Reg.No.KA40 B0462 came in high speed rash and negligently and dashed against his motor cycle from back side,
due to the said impact, he fell down and sustained grievous injuries.

Immediately after the accident,
he was taken to Government Hospital Chikkaballapura, after first aid he was shifted to NIMHANS Hospital Bengaluru, thereafter shifted to Sanjay Gandhi Trauma and Orthopaedic Centre Bengaluru,

3. At the time of the accident he was aged about 48 years, hale and healthy, doing agriculture and milk vending business, thereby earning Rs.30,000/ p.m., due to this accident he is unable to do his business and has lost source of income and earning capacity.

Out of this accident crime No.182/2022 is registered against the driver of the said Mahindra Bolero Goods Carrier Vehicle bearing Reg.No.KA40B0462 before the Gudibande Police for the offences punishable under Sec.279 and 337 of IPC.
R1 is the insurer, R2 is the owner of the said offending vehicle, they are jointly and severally liable to pay compensation.
Hence, prays to allow the petition and grant compensation of Rs.12,00,000/ with interest at the rate of 18% p.a. SCCH5 4.

2. Whether the Petitioner is entitled for compensation? If so how much and from whom?
3. What order or award?

Considering contributory negligence by both the parties, this tribunal comes to the conclusion that, SCCH5 80% of the award amount i.e., Rs.4,46,831/ (80% of Rs.5,58,539/) shall be paid by R1 along with interest at the rate of 6% p.a. within 60 days from the date of petition till realization of entire amount.
Remaining 20% of the amount i.e., Rs.1,11,708/ (20% of Rs.5,58,539/) shall be borne by the petitioner.
Accordingly, I have answered Issue No.3 partly in affirmative.
22. Issue No.3:
For the reasons assigned to Issues No.1 and 2, I proceed to pass the following:

::ORDER::
The petition filed by the Petitioner under Sec.166 of the M.V. Act, 1989 is partly allowed with cost.

The Petitioner is entitled for compensation of Rs.4,46,831/ (Rupees Four Lakhs Forty Six Thousand Eight Hundred Thirty One Only) i.e., 80% of Rs.5,58,539/ with interest at the rate of 6% p.a. from the date of petition till its realization SCCH5 which shall be paid by respondent No.1 along with interest within 60 days from the date of this order.
Remaining 20% compensation of Rs.1,11,708/ i.e., 20% of Rs.5,58,539/ shall be borne by the petitioner.

The Petitioner is entitled to get release 60% of the award amount through epayment directly to his account on furnishing the Bank A/c details along with address proof and remaining 40% shall be kept in Fixed Deposit in any of the Scheduled Bank for a period of three years, in his name.

Draw award accordingly.
